steps.title: Empty project start
steps.caption: A new, empty project is open on NOTE MASKS for channel 1 before the first course action. No mask is set.

steps.title: Open channel 1
steps.caption: You start from a new, empty project: transport stopped, nothing set up, channel 1 selected. Tap Channel (3,8), the third button on the bottom row. The screen opens NOTE MASKS for CH01 with eight cells (Trig, Note, Vel, Len and Chd1 to Chd4) that all read X: no value is set, because a new channel has no pattern, pitch or sound yet. On the grid, (1,1) is lit because channel 1 is the channel you edit, and (3,8) is lit because it is the page you are on.

steps.title: Try the Pattern button
steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8), the fifth button on the bottom row. The grid and screen switch to the pattern editor: the title row reads PATTERN TRIG with PAT01 CH01, and every step is dim because pattern 1 has no trigs yet. (1,1) is lit because pattern 1 is the pattern you edit, and (5,8) is lit because you are on the Pattern page.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: A new, empty project with the transport stopped and nothing assigned to a channel. The pattern editor from chapter 1 is on screen. Channel 1 has no output chosen yet and no tempo has been set; the rest of the course uses MIDI port 1, MIDI channel 1 for channel 1.

steps.title: Open Channel tasks
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then turn E1 right three detents. The title row reads CHANNEL TASKS with CH01: a list of the pages of channel 1, each marked OPEN >, with the footer Channel Editor. This list is how you reach every channel page (Masks, Trig params, Output, Clock, Merge modes, Merge Shape, Harmony, Device and History).

steps.title: Select Device
steps.caption: In Channel tasks, move E2 to Device. The selected row reads OPEN >, so K3 opens its settings.

steps.title: Open Device
steps.caption: Turn E2 down the list to Device, the eighth task (seven detents below Masks), and press K3. The title row reads DEVICE with CH01. Only the Device row is listed, set to None: the MIDI channel and MIDI port rows appear once you choose a device.

steps.title: Choose CC Device (draft)
steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent to choose the first entry after None, CC Device (a generic MIDI device). DEVICE CH01 now lists Device CC Device, MIDI channel CC1 and MIDI port OUT 1. This is only a draft; K2 cancels it and K3 applies it.

steps.title: Choose a device and apply it
steps.caption: Press K3 to apply the draft. Notes from channel 1 now leave on MIDI port 1, MIDI channel 1. With your own gear, choose its device entry and set its port and channel; with no external gear, choose Polyperc 1 for the norns voice.

steps.title: Open Tempo
steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), turn E1 right one detent to Song tasks, turn E2 to Tempo & feel and press K3, then turn E2 up to Tempo. GLOBAL FEEL for SONG 01 lists Tempo, Swing type and Swing, and Tempo shows the norns clock tempo; in this recording it already reads 90, the value every timing in the chapters ahead assumes. On your norns it may read something else, such as 120.

steps.title: Read Tempo before confirming
steps.caption: Turn E3 until GLOBAL FEEL reads Tempo 90. Check the displayed value, then press K3 to finish.

steps.title: Set the tempo to 90
steps.caption: Tempo moves one BPM per detent between 30 and 300, with no coarse step. To see it work, turn E3 left or right and watch the number follow, then bring it back to 90 and press K3 to apply. GLOBAL FEEL shows Tempo 90, which makes a beat exactly 2/3 s for every timing in the chapters ahead.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: The project from chapter 2: channel 1 sends to a MIDI instrument on port 1, MIDI channel 1 (its Device page shows CC Device, MIDI channel CC1, MIDI port OUT 1), and the tempo is 90 BPM (GLOBAL FEEL shows Tempo 90). No pattern has trigs yet, nothing is assigned to a channel and playback is stopped.

steps.title: Enter four trigs
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 1 at (1,1), then tap (1,4), (2,4), (3,4) and (4,4). Row 4 holds steps 1 to 16, so these are the first four steps. PATTERN TRIG PAT01 CH01 shows four bright trigs at the left of row 4. Four neighbouring trigs are a deliberately plain rhythm to hear first; chapter 4 spreads them out.

steps.title: Assign pattern 1
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then tap (1,2), the first pattern slot on row 2, to give channel 1 pattern 1. Mosaic opens MERGE MODES for CH01 because assigning a pattern always shows it, and the tooltip reads Pattern 1 added to ch. 1. Patterns reads 01; ignore the other rows for now.

steps.title: Loop four steps
steps.caption: Row 4 of the channel page is the range row: hold (1,4), tap (4,4) and release (1,4) to loop only steps 1 to 4. Steps 1 to 4 stay bright, the rest go dark, and the tooltip reads Channel 1 length changed.

steps.title: Open Masks
steps.caption: Turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 lists eight cells (Trig, Note, Vel, Len and Chd1 to Chd4), all X: no mask is set, so the channel has no pitch, velocity or length yet. With no step held, E2 chooses a cell and E3 sets that cell for every step of the channel.

steps.title: Set the channel note
steps.caption: Turn E2 to Note and E3 until the channel default reads C3.

steps.title: Set the channel velocity
steps.caption: Turn E2 to Vel and E3 until the channel default reads 80.

steps.title: Give the trigs a pitch, level and length
steps.caption: Select Note with E2 and turn E3 right until it reads C3 (it starts at X, so about 60 detents), select Vel and turn E3 right to 80 (about 80 detents), then select Len and turn E3 right to 1/2 (8 detents). NOTE MASKS CH01 now lists Note C3, Vel 80 and Len 1/2, the defaults for every step.

steps.title: Play and stop
steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), listen for two repeats of the four-step loop, then tap Play again. While it plays the screen stays on NOTE MASKS, the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows note 60 (C3) at velocity 80 about every 167 ms (1/6 s): four notes per repeat, so you hear a fast stutter rather than a tune. Stop leaves no note sounding. This confirms the whole chain (pattern, channel, masks, output) before you shape the rhythm.

steps.title: Stop and confirm the note setup remains
steps.caption: Stop playback. The note, velocity and length settings remain C3, 80 and 1/2.

scenes.title: 4. Spread the rhythm across a bar

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Pattern 1 has trigs on steps 1 to 4 and is assigned to channel 1, which loops steps 1 to 4. Channel 1's Masks are Note C3 (60), Vel 80 and Len 1/2, and the tempo is 90 BPM. Playback is stopped.

steps.title: Loop all 16 steps
steps.caption: Hold (1,4), tap (16,4) and release (1,4): the range is now 16 steps, one bar. On row 4, steps 5 to 16 now glow dimly because they are inside the loop (they were dark at range 4), and the trigs are still on steps 1 to 4. Then open the Clock page for the next step: turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Clock and press K3.

steps.title: Read the selected rate
steps.caption: On CLOCK CH01, check that Rate reads /1 before pressing K3.

steps.title: Check the rate
steps.caption: Select Rate (the top row of the CLOCK page; turn E2 up if it is not highlighted) and press K3. CLOCK CH01 shows Rate /1, the default sixteenth-note rate: each step lasts 1/6 s at 90 BPM and the 16 steps last 2.7 s. Nothing changes here; this confirms the rate that every timing in the course relies on.

steps.title: Move the trigs onto the beats
steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8), tap (2,4), (3,4) and (4,4) to remove those trigs, then tap (5,4), (9,4) and (13,4) to add trigs. Keep (1,4). PATTERN TRIG PAT01 CH01 shows trigs on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13: four steps apart is one beat at 90 BPM.

steps.title: Open Masks for the next chapter
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note C3, Vel 80 and Len 1/2 as before, and row 4 of the grid shows the four trigs one beat apart inside the 16-step range. Masks stays open so chapter 5 starts on the page it needs.

steps.title: Hear the longer phrase
steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two 16-step passes run (about 5.3 s), then tap Play to stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4, one beat at a time over the four trigs. The MIDI strip shows note 60 (C3) at velocity 80 once per beat, about 667 ms (2/3 s) apart: the same note as chapter 3, spread over a bar instead of 167 ms apart. Stop leaves no note sounding.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1, trigs on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13, over steps 1 to 16 at Rate /1 and 90 BPM. Its channel masks are Note C3 (60), Vel 80 and Len 1/2, and the NOTE MASKS page is open; no step has a mask yet. Playback is stopped.

steps.title: Find the channel default
steps.caption: With no step held, turn E2 to Note. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note C3 in the highlighted cell. With no step number in the title row, C3 is the default for every step of the channel; no step has a mask of its own yet.

steps.title: Select the last beat
steps.caption: Hold (13,4), the fourth trig, and keep holding it. The title row changes to CH01 ST13: from now the screen edits step 13 only, and its Note still reads C3 because step 13 has no exception yet.

steps.title: Raise the last note
steps.caption: While you hold (13,4), turn E3 right two detents. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3: a pitch for step 13 only, two semitones above the default.

steps.title: Release the step
steps.caption: Release (13,4). The title row returns to CH01 and Note shows the channel default C3 again. Step 13 still keeps D3: hold (13,4) again to see it, or listen in the next step.

steps.title: Hold the step again
steps.caption: Hold (13,4) again. The title row returns to CH01 ST13 and Note reads D3: step 13 kept its own note when you let go, and holding it is how you see it. Release (13,4) before the next step.

steps.title: Hear the new ending
steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), listen to two passes, then tap Play to stop. The screen is back on the channel defaults, the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows C, C, C, D: steps 1, 5 and 9 sound note 60 and step 13 sounds note 62, all at velocity 80, one beat apart.

steps.title: Make the ending softer
steps.caption: Select Vel with E2, hold (13,4) and turn E3 left 30 detents. While you hold it, NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Vel 50 and Note D3: both belong to step 13 alone. Keep holding for this frame, then release (13,4).

steps.title: Hear the softer ending
steps.caption: After you release (13,4) the screen shows the channel default Vel 80 again. Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows notes 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and note 62 at velocity 50.

steps.title: Set the channel default to G3
steps.caption: With no step held, select Note with E2 and turn E3 right seven detents to G3 (MIDI 67, seven semitones above C). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note G3: the default for the whole channel changed.

steps.title: Check step 13 kept its own note
steps.caption: Hold (13,4) again. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 still shows Note D3 and Vel 50: step 13 keeps its own values whatever the channel default says. Release (13,4).

steps.title: Hear the new default
steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 67, 67, 67 on steps 1, 5 and 9 and 62 at velocity 50 on step 13: you hear G, G, G, D because step 13 keeps its own note.

steps.title: Restore the channel default
steps.caption: Turn E3 left seven detents. The NOTE MASKS screen now shows the channel Note default as C3. Step 13 keeps its own D3 and velocity 50 exception.

steps.title: Hear the restored default
steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60, 62 again, and step 13 is still at velocity 50.

steps.title: Hold step 13 before clearing
steps.caption: Hold (13,4) and keep holding it. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 and Vel 50, the exceptions you built for this step.

steps.title: Clear it with K2
steps.caption: While you still hold (13,4), press K2. The tooltip reads Masks for step 13 cleared and the screen shows Note C3 and Vel 80, the channel defaults: K2 on a held step removes every mask on that step and leaves the channel defaults alone. Release (13,4).

steps.title: Hear the cleared step
steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 60 at velocity 80 on all four steps.

steps.title: Rebuild: raise step 13 to D3
steps.caption: Rebuild the ending with the two edits you already know. Select Note, hold (13,4) and turn E3 right two detents: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 while you hold.

steps.title: Rebuild: step 13 velocity 50
steps.caption: Release, select Vel, hold (13,4) and turn E3 left 30 detents: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 and Vel 50 together. Release (13,4).

steps.title: Hear the rebuilt ending
steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and 62 at velocity 50.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Channel 1 plays C, C, C, D over 16 steps at 90 BPM: step 13 has Note D3 (62) and Vel 50, the other trigs use C3 at 80. Channel 2, pattern 2 and a second MIDI output are still to be set up.

steps.title: Enter two bass trigs
steps.caption: Pattern 2 starts empty. Tap Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 2 at (2,1) and tap (1,4) and (9,4) for two trigs. PATTERN TRIG PAT02 CH01 shows the two trigs as bright squares on steps 1 and 9, and the tooltip reads Pattern 2 selected.

steps.title: Give them notes
steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8) again to open the note view, then tap (1,7) for degree 0 on step 1 and (9,3) for degree 4 on step 9. PATTERN NOTE PAT02 shows the tooltip Step 9 note set to 4. Only those two note taps are yours: the bright band along row 7 is the note view's degree 0 baseline, and the extra pad at (13,6) is not one of your notes and does not play. It is the note view also showing what channel 1 last played on step 13, D3 (degree 1); pattern 2 has no trig there.

steps.title: Open Channel tasks for channel 2
steps.caption: Turn E1 clockwise to open the channel-2 task list.

steps.title: Select Device for channel 2
steps.caption: Move E2 to Device. The selected row reads OPEN >.

steps.title: Open channel 2's Device page
steps.caption: Open the Device page for channel 2. The visible value is None; the channel and port selectors appear after a device is chosen.

steps.title: Choose the instrument
steps.caption: Turn E3 clockwise once to choose CC Device. Channel 2 will use its own MIDI channel and port.

steps.title: Give the bass its own MIDI channel
steps.caption: Select MIDI Channel with E2, then turn E3 clockwise once to CC2. The visible route now reads CC Device, CC2, OUT 1.

steps.title: Set the bass output port
steps.caption: Select MIDI Port with E2, then turn E3 clockwise once to OUT 2. The selected value reads OUT 2; the Device row is above this scrolled view.

steps.title: Apply the second output
steps.caption: Press K3 to apply the route. The visible values remain CC Device, CC2, OUT 2, and the last line reads OK.

steps.title: Assign pattern 2
steps.caption: Tap (2,2) to give channel 2 pattern 2. MERGE MODES for CH02 shows Patterns 02 and the tooltip reads Pattern 2 added to ch. 2.

steps.title: Loop 16 steps
steps.caption: Set the range, a gesture and not a trig: hold (1,4), tap (16,4) and release (1,4), so channel 2 loops the same 16 steps as channel 1. The tooltip reads Channel 2 length changed.

steps.title: Drop it an octave
steps.caption: Tap (9,8) for octave -1. The screen reads NOTE MASKS CH02 OCT-1 and the tooltip shows Ch. 2 octave: -1; (2,2) and (9,8) are lit.

steps.title: Hear the two parts
steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two passes run, then tap Play to stop. While it plays the screen stays on NOTE MASKS CH02 OCT-1 and the Play pad (1,8) is lit. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 on port 1: notes 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and 62 at velocity 50, a beat apart. Channel 2 is on port 2: note 48 on step 1 and note 55 on step 9, both at velocity 100. That is the phrase above a low C and G.

steps.title: Add pattern 2 to channel 1 (Skip)
steps.caption: Optional detour. Select channel 1 at (1,1) and tap pattern slot (2,2) to add pattern 2 next to pattern 1: MERGE MODES shows Patterns 01 02 and Strategy SKIP, the default. Play two passes and stop. Skip plays a step only when exactly one assigned pattern has a trig there, so with both patterns trigging steps 1 and 9, only steps 5 and 13 stay bright on row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding only 60 and 62 at velocity 50; the bass (48, 55) is unchanged.

steps.title: Press the merge button once
steps.caption: Tap (14,8) once. MERGE MODES shows Strategy ONLY with the tooltip ONLY APPLIED, and the (14,8) button changes brightness. The button steps through Skip, Only, All and further strategies. Only plays a step only when more than one assigned pattern has a trig there: on row 4 just steps 1 and 9 stay bright.

steps.title: Hear Only
steps.caption: Play two passes and stop, with Strategy still ONLY. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding only note 60 at velocity 80, on steps 1 and 9, two beats apart; the bass (48, 55) is unchanged. These are exactly the steps Skip silenced.

steps.title: Merge mode All
steps.caption: Tap (14,8) once more: Strategy reads ALL and all four trigs on row 4 light again. Play two passes and stop. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 60, 60, 60, 62 (velocity 80, 80, 80, 50): channel 1's Note and Vel masks supply the pitch and velocity, whichever pattern's trig fires.

steps.title: Remove pattern 2 again
steps.caption: Tap (2,2) to remove pattern 2 from channel 1, then play two passes and stop. MERGE MODES now shows Patterns 01. Channel 1 plays pattern 1 alone, 60, 60, 60, 62, and channel 2 keeps 48 and 55. Strategy stays on ALL, which makes no difference with one pattern. Another tap of (14,8) would move on to a different strategy this course does not use, so leave it.

scenes.title: 7. Change harmony without changing the rhythm

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 alone, C, C, C, D, from channel and step masks: Note C3 (60), Vel 80, and on step 13 Note D3 (62) at Vel 50; NOTE MASKS CH01 is open. Channel 2 plays pattern 2 (degrees 0 and 4, octave -1) as MIDI 48 and 55. The merge Strategy is still All, which changes nothing with one pattern. Scale slot 1 is C major and the tempo is 90 BPM.

steps.title: Let the pattern notes through
steps.caption: Turn E2 to Note and turn E3 left until it reads X (no mask). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X: the channel no longer decides the pitch, the pattern notes will.

steps.title: Restore the quiet ending
steps.caption: Hold (13,4) and press K2: the tooltip reads Masks for step 13 cleared, and K2 removes every mask on the step, so its Note 62 and Vel 50 both go. Then select Vel, turn E3 left 30 detents to 50 while still holding: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note X and Vel 50, the quiet ending back on step 13 alone. Release (13,4).

steps.title: Back to the channel defaults
steps.caption: Release (13,4). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X and Vel 80 (the channel defaults); step 13's own Vel 50 only shows while you hold it.

steps.title: Write the melody as degrees
steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 1 at (1,1), tap Pattern (5,8) again for the note view and tap (1,7), (5,7), (9,7) and (13,6): degree 0 on steps 1, 5 and 9, and degree 1, one row up and the next note of the scale, on step 13. PATTERN NOTE PAT01 CH01 shows the tooltip Step 13 note set to 1.

steps.title: Play it from the pattern
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), play two passes and stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 60, 60, 60, 62 from the pattern's own notes, step 13 at velocity 50, and channel 2 sounding 48 and 55.

steps.title: Prepare a second scale
steps.caption: Tap Scale (4,8) to open the scale page, tap scale slot 2 at (2,3), then play two passes and stop. While it plays the screen shows SCALE SLOT 02 with Root C and Scale Major. Slot 2 holds C major like slot 1, so nothing changes: the MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60, 62 on channel 1 and 48 and 55 on channel 2. Ignore the Degree and Transpose rows on this page; they stay at I and 0.

steps.title: Draft D as the root
steps.caption: Turn E2 to Root and turn E3 right two detents to D. SCALE SLOT 02 shows Root D, Scale Major and the line Press K3 to confirm. The change is only a draft until K3, so playback would still use C major.

steps.title: Check the Scale row
steps.caption: Turn E2 down to Scale. SCALE SLOT 02 shows Scale Major beside the draft Root D, and Press K3 to confirm is still on screen: nothing is applied yet.

steps.title: Apply D major
steps.caption: Press K3 to apply: the Press K3 to confirm line disappears. Play two passes and stop. While it plays SCALE SLOT 02 shows Root D and the Play pad (1,8) is lit. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 62, 62, 62, 64 (the last at velocity 50) and channel 2 sounding 50 and 57: the same rhythm in D major.

steps.title: Return to C major
steps.caption: Tap scale slot 1 at (1,3), press K3 to apply, then play two passes and stop. SCALE SLOT 01 shows Root C. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 back on 60, 60, 60, 62 and channel 2 on 48 and 55.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: The project at the end of chapter 7: channel 1 plays degrees 0, 0, 0, 1 from pattern 1 with step 13 at velocity 50, channel 2 plays its bass, and C major is applied. Step 15 has no trig. Playback is stopped.

steps.title: Add the late trig
steps.caption: Choose pattern 1, tap (15,4) on Pattern Trig to add a trig on step 15, press Pattern (5,8) once to open the note view and tap (15,7) for degree 0. PATTERN NOTE PAT01 CH01 shows the tooltip Step 15 note set to 0 and a trig stripe on steps 1, 5, 9, 13 and 15.

steps.title: Open Masks
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X (the pattern notes decide pitch), Vel 80 and Len 1/2: the channel defaults the new trig will use until you give step 15 its own velocity.

steps.title: Set step 15 to velocity 35
steps.caption: Select Vel with E2, hold (15,4) and turn E3 left 45 detents until Vel reads 35. While you hold the step, NOTE MASKS CH01 ST15 shows Vel 35, that step's own value. Keep holding for this frame, then release (15,4).

steps.title: Hear the quiet pickup
steps.caption: After you release, the screen shows the channel default Vel 80 again. Play two passes and stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows the phrase (60 at velocity 80, then 62 at 50) and a quiet 60 at velocity 35 on step 15, just before the bar restarts.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Slot 1 holds the whole project, including the pickup on step 15 at velocity 35. Global length is the default 64, Repeats is 1 and Song mode is On; slots 2 and 3 are empty. Playback is stopped.

steps.title: Copy the complete section
steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), hold slot 1 at (1,1), tap slot 2 at (2,1), release slot 1 and tap (2,1) again to select slot 2. Holding slot 1 while you tap slot 2 copies the whole section (patterns, channel settings, masks and mutes). The screen reads SLOT SETUP, SONG 02, the tooltip says Song sequence 2 selected, and (2,1) is the bright slot button. The next two steps check the copy: slot 2 stays audible when slot 1 is muted.

steps.title: Mute channel 1 in slot 1
steps.caption: Select slot 1 at (1,1), tap Channel (3,8), then hold K1, tap (1,1) and release K1. K1 is the shift key from chapter 1: K1 plus a channel button mutes that channel in this slot only. The title reads CH01 MUTE and the tooltip says Channel 1 muted: slot 1 will play the bass alone.

steps.title: Check slot 2 stays full
steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 2 at (2,1) and tap Channel (3,8). The title reads CH01 S02 with no MUTE: channel 1 is audible in slot 2, so slot 2 keeps the full phrase.

steps.title: Set slot 1 to one bar
steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 1 at (1,1), tap (3,7) on the length fader, then tap (8,7) three times. The fader is row 7, columns 1 to 8: (3,7) jumps to 13 steps and each tap of (8,7) adds one, so 13 + 3 = 16. SONG PLAYBACK, SONG 01 shows Global length 16; Song mode reads AUTO there, which means Song mode is on and advancing.

steps.title: Optional: check Repeats for slot 1
steps.caption: Optional check. Open Slot setup from Song tasks (E1 right one detent, E2 to Slot setup, K3), select Repeats, turn E3 left until it reads 1 and press K3. Repeats already starts at 1: SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 shows Repeats 1.

steps.title: Set slot 2 to one bar
steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 2 at (2,1), tap (3,7), then tap (8,7) three times: 13 + 3 = 16 again. SONG PLAYBACK, SONG 02 shows Global length 16.

steps.title: Optional: check Repeats for slot 2
steps.caption: Optional check. Open Slot setup, select Repeats, turn E3 left until it reads 1 and press K3. SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Repeats 1, the default.

steps.title: Read Song mode before confirming
steps.caption: Check SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Song mode On before pressing K3.

steps.title: Optional: check Song mode
steps.caption: Optional check. In Slot setup select Song mode, turn E3 right to On and press K3. SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Song mode On, the default: the song moves from slot 1 to slot 2 and wraps to slot 1 because slot 3 is empty.

steps.title: Hear slot 1
steps.caption: Select slot 1, tap Play (1,8) and listen to slot 1 first. SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 stays on screen with Song mode On, the slot button (1,1) is bright, and the MIDI strip shows only the bass (port 2: note 48, then 55, velocity 100) because channel 1 is muted in this slot.

steps.title: Hear slot 2 join
steps.caption: Keep listening for the second section (about 2.7 s later) and then tap Play to stop; four 16-step sections run in all (about 10.7 s). The screen follows the song to SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 and the bright slot button moves to (2,1). The MIDI strip now shows the phrase on port 1 (60, 60, 60 at velocity 80, 62 at 50 and the pickup 60 at 35) joining the bass, only in the sections that play slot 2.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Starting point
steps.caption: Slot 1 has channel 1 muted and slot 2 has both channels audible, each 16 steps with Repeats 1 and Song mode On. The project has not been saved under a name yet and playback is stopped.

steps.title: Open Save project
steps.caption: Tap K1 briefly for the norns menu, turn E1 to PARAMS and press K3, open MOSAIC and turn E2 to < Save project. The norns menu lists Pattern project management with Save project selected.

steps.title: Save the arrangement
steps.caption: Press K3 on < Save project. The norns text entry screen opens with the suggested name new: press K3 on DEL to delete it, then turn E2 to each character of Four notes and press K3 to enter it, and confirm. Saving writes Four notes.ptn and Four notes.pset. Tap K1 to return to Mosaic, which still shows SLOT SETUP, SONG 01; the text entry itself is on the norns menu, not on this frame.

steps.title: Make an unsaved change
steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then hold K1, tap (1,1) and release K1. The title reads CH01 with no MUTE and the tooltip says Channel 1 unmuted: slot 1 now plays the phrase. This change is not saved.

steps.title: Open Load project
steps.caption: Tap K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC and turn E2 to > Load project. The norns menu shows Load project selected; K2 would cancel the dialog.

steps.title: Select Four notes
steps.caption: Turn E2 until Four notes.ptn is highlighted. Confirm the filename before pressing K3 to load it.

steps.title: Reload the saved version
steps.caption: Press K3 on > Load project, turn E2 to Four notes in the file list and press K3, then tap K1 to return to Mosaic and tap Channel (3,8). The title reads CH01 MUTE again: the unsaved change is gone and slot 1 is bass alone.

steps.title: Replay slot 1
steps.caption: Select slot 1, tap Play (1,8) and listen. SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 is on screen and the bass alone (48, 55) sounds, as before the save.

steps.title: Replay slot 2
steps.caption: Keep listening: the screen follows the song to SONG 02 and the phrase and pickup join the bass, as in chapter 9. Let four 16-step sections run, then tap Play to stop. The MIDI strip lists the same notes as the arrangement in chapter 9.
